name: Feature matrix
author: Brett
description: Every build gets a feature matrix (feature-matrix@1): grouped items, each with its minutes, model (Fable / Opus) and why; tick = keep, untick = skip; items can be added any time and are never deleted. All matrices are one dataset, shown as a grid of expandable rows (row = build: profile, date added, time cost of the kept items, kept / skipped, needs apply, last applied). Editing lights Apply, which pushes the totals, skips and estimates to every table the build lives in (orchestrator, pending list, build queue, build manager / change log, plan) through the framework's Apply engine. Every builds grid gets a row button and a right-click 'Feature matrix' (lib-datagrid row hooks). Files: _claude/builds/[profiles/<id>/]matrices.json, mirrored to the plugin data folder.
